title: Energy Estimation for Virtual Servers Using Resource Utilization and Machine Learning
abstract: arXiv:2509.09991v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Estimating the energy use of virtual servers is difficult because physical power interfaces and privileged host counters are typically accessible only on the underlying physical host. We investigate a machine learning approach that predicts the CPU-package power attributable to an individual virtual server from system and performance metrics observable within that virtual server itself. During training, host-side RAPL measurements provide the power target used to learn this mapping, while deployed inference requires only measurements available within the virtual server. We evaluate the approach across heterogeneous CPU platforms, multiple workload families, unseen workloads and hardware, concurrent workload combinations, and varying resource allocations using temporally blocked evaluation. translated_title: 基于资源利用率与机器学习的虚拟服务器能耗估算
translated_abstract: 估算虚拟服务器的能耗十分困难，因为物理电源接口和特权主机计数器通常只能在底层物理主机上访问。我们研究了一种机器学习方法，该方法利用虚拟服务器内部可观测的系统和性能指标，来预测归属于单个虚拟服务器的CPU封装功耗。在训练阶段，主机侧的RAPL测量提供用于学习该映射关系的功耗目标值，而部署推理时则只需要虚拟服务器内部可获取的测量数据。我们采用时间分块评估方法，在异构CPU平台、多种工作负载类型、未见过的负载与硬件、并发工作负载组合以及不同资源配置等条件下对该方法进行了评估。当部署条件在训练期间得到覆盖时，预测效果总体较强，而向未见过的负载和硬件进行零样本迁移的效果则……
tldr: 该论文提出一种机器学习方法，仅利用虚拟服务器内部可观测的系统和性能指标即可预测单个虚拟服务器的CPU功耗，训练时以主机侧RAPL测量作为功耗标签，在训练覆盖部署条件时预测效果良好。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a machine learning approach that predicts the CPU-package power of individual virtual servers using only system and performance metrics observable within the VM, with host-side RAPL measurements as training targets, achieving strong predictions when deployment conditions are represented during training.
